lines.text: 保冷剤の中身って、ほとんど水だって知ってた？
prompts: a blue ice pack on a bright kitchen table next to a lunch box, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a small ice pack in a cooler bag with a sandwich, bright daylight, cheerful

lines.text: 一般的な保冷剤は、約98%が水だと言われているよ。
prompts: a glass of clear water on a bright wooden table, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a friendly cartoon water drop beside a small ice pack, bright daylight, cheerful

lines.text: 残りの約2%は、水を固める高吸水性ポリマーという粉。
prompts: a spoon of white fine powder on a bright table, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a bright kitchen scene with a small bowl of powder and a measuring spoon, cheerful

lines.text: この粉は、水をぷるぷるのゼリー状にしてくれるんだ。
prompts: a wobbly clear jelly in a small bowl, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a transparent gel-like pack held on a bright table, bright daylight, cheerful

lines.text: 紙おむつにも使われている、水をたっぷり吸う素材だよ。
prompts: a soft white cloth diaper and a baby toy on a bright table, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style

lines.text: ただし、商品によって成分は違うので、誤って口にしないでね。
prompts: a parent putting an ice pack on a high shelf away from a toy, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
a bright kitchen shelf with an ice pack stored safely, cheerful

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a cozy bright kitchen with a lunch box and an ice pack on the table, bright daylight, cheerful storybook style
